_snapshotData.name: Gen Digital Inc.
_snapshotData.description: Gen Digital Inc. engages in the provision of cyber safety and trust-based solutions for individuals, families, and small businesses. The company offers security and performance management, identity protection, and online privacy, as well as technology platforms. It also provides restoration support services, digital reputation, and secure financial wellness. The company offers its products under the Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender, and CCleaner brands. The company was formerly known as NortonLifeLock Inc. and changed its name to Gen Digital Inc. in November 2022. Gen Digital Inc. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: Gen Digital Inc. possesses a narrow economic moat (score: 51/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (strong) and Switching Costs (moderate). Gen Digital Inc.

supply_side.explanation: Gen Digital Inc. has strong supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 12.2% with earnings growing at 128.6% — positive 116.4% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 77.4% and operating margins of 37.4% at at current scale.

network_effects.explanation: Gen Digital Inc. has limited demand-side economies of scale. Software - Infrastructure suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: Gen Digital Inc. has weak learning curve advantages. Software - Infrastructure has limited knowledge barriers. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: Gen Digital Inc. benefits from moderate switching costs. Software - Infrastructure offers relatively easy substitution. 77% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 12.2% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: Software - Infrastructure has limited AI disruption risk. Physical infrastructure, regulatory moats, and tangible assets provide insulation.

aiDisruption.net_assessment: Gen Digital Inc. faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
